segments.caption: A large commercial airplane descends for landing against a hazy, golden sky, its silhouette clearly visible as it approaches the runway, which stretches toward a distant city skyline framed by a line of trees.
A large commercial airliner, with its landing lights illuminated, descends steadily toward a runway at dusk, its approach framed by a hazy, golden sky and a distant cityscape beyond a line of trees.

An airplane descends steadily for landing against a hazy, golden sunset, its landing gear down and lights illuminated as it approaches the runway, with a distant city skyline visible beyond a line of trees.

A large passenger airplane is captured in a continuous sequence of landing, its nose gear touching down on the runway and creating a visible plume of smoke and dust as it decelerates under the warm, hazy light of either sunrise or sunset. The scene is framed by a foreground of green trees and distant city buildings silhouetted against the orange sky.

A large passenger airplane, viewed from the front, steadily approaches and taxis down the runway at an airport during a hazy, golden-hour sunset. The aircraft’s landing lights are illuminated as it moves toward the camera, with a line of trees and distant city buildings visible on the horizon under the warm, orange sky.

A large, four-engine passenger jet taxis steadily down the runway toward the camera, its nose lights glowing brightly against the hazy, golden-orange sky of either sunrise or sunset. The aircraft is framed by a foreground of green trees, with a distant city skyline visible on the horizon.

A massive four-engine airliner, viewed from the front, steadily advances down the runway at sunset. Its landing lights blaze brightly against the warm, hazy orange sky as it prepares for takeoff, with a distant treeline and city buildings forming the backdrop.

A large, white Boeing 747, identifiable as Air Force One by its markings and the American flag on the tail, taxis along an airport runway during a hazy, golden-hour sunset. The aircraft, with "UNITED STATES OF AMERICA" written along its fuselage, moves steadily from the center of the frame toward the right, eventually exiting the shot.
